overview: The second day of the seventh annual Medford Jazz Festival featured performances by the Farai Malik Quintet and the Mina Cho Quartet at the West Medford Community Center.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Sponsorship Recognition
items.summary: Jonathan Fagan opened the event by thanking sponsors including the Medford Arts Council and the Arts Alive Foundation, noting the festival's growth since 2020.

items.title: Historical Context of West Medford Community Center
items.summary: Terry Carter shared the 90-year history of the center, describing it as the traditional heart of Medford's African-American community and a response to historical redlining.

items.title: Farai Malik Quintet Performance
items.summary: The Farai Malik Quintet performed a set of original Americana and jazz-influenced compositions, including the singles 'Every Heartbeat' and 'Prayer for the People'.

items.title: Mina Cho Quartet Performance
items.summary: The Mina Cho Quartet presented a set of 'Gugak Jazz,' blending traditional Korean rhythms and melodies with modern jazz improvisation.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Previews
items.summary: Terry Carter thanked the performers and sponsors while previewing the Sunday lineup and encouraging community donations.
